purpose: Separate availability of predictive information from learnability of recurrent state by matching public information to trained conventional controls.
public_observation_contract: At time t, learner sees o_t, public a_t, all prior public o/a. It predicts o_(t+1). Hidden state, next observation, future actions, family identity and role are withheld from learner input.

training.fit_selection: minimum PUBLIC_SELECT Bernoulli next-bit NLL; no DEV-driven selection
training.fixed_optimizer: episode-level exact recurrent sensitivity gradient; no hidden-state supervision

development_metrics: mean NLL delta versus strongest conventional
decision: Report all signed gains/losses; public development screening ONLY. O3 offers no sealed scientific GO, no native Wingless/Yggdrasil qualification, no ITD-01 unfamiliar transfer claim.
constraints: All arms use identical public observations and actions.
No hidden state labels or privileged family selector inside learner.
No DEV-based tuning, model selection, adaptation, seed changes or budget revision.
Q20 DEV NO-GO and Q21/Q21N01 frozen history remain untouched.
No Q20/Q21/Q21N01 role cohorts, protected originals, FSA grant or research dispatch.
No new scheduler/controller, CKB-private dependency, new paid service or acceptance mutation.
Negative findings, failed runs and indeterminate cases retained.
next_boundary: If a predictive-state representation demonstrates development advantage, investigate identity-proven mechanism ablation/retention on independent prospective task families with equally informed strong conventional comparators and admitted scientific custody.
